---
name: Skill Request
about: Request a new QA skill (e.g. new test type, new report format, new integration)
title: '[SKILL] '
labels: skill-request
assignees: afmelwekeel
---

## Skill Name
What would you call this skill? (e.g. `visual-regression`, `api-testing`, `load-testing`)

## What Should It Do?
Describe the skill's purpose in one sentence.

## Inputs
What does the skill need to run?
- [ ] User story file
- [ ] Suite name
- [ ] Test results
- [ ] Other: ___

## Outputs
What should the skill produce?
- [ ] Test cases (XLSX/MD)
- [ ] E2E test files (Playwright)
- [ ] Report (HTML/XLSX/MD)
- [ ] Other: ___

## Which Phase?
Which phase of the 7-phase pipeline does this skill belong to?
- Phase 0 — Project detection
- Phase 1 — Story analysis
- Phase 2 — Test case generation
- Phase 3 — E2E generation
- Phase 4 — Test data generation
- Phase 5 — Test execution
- Phase 6 — Bug analysis
- Phase 7 — Reporting
- Standalone (not part of the pipeline)

## Why This Skill?
What use case or gap does this fill that existing skills don't cover?
